title: Latest station count
description: The published file latest-station-count.json: the latest count of each station of AMBici and Bicing, produced by the pipeline and read by the page.

data_instant.description: Capture instant of the file's most recent data, in UTC.

num_vehicles_available.description: Vehicles available for rental; null while a Bicing station is out of service.

num_docks_available.description: Free docks; null where the source publishes none.

last_reported.description: The station's last_reported as its source publishes it, in UTC.

captured_at.description: Capture instant of the station's count, in UTC.
